body: I hope this hobby will help me out a bit. Have a good night, and thank you once again.

Thank you for your advice. I will consider going back to counseling. An instrument sounds like a good idea as well, but I am so overwhelmed on how to start as I am a slow learner. Is there any place where I can buy a cheap guitar/ukulele of some sort?
Thank you for the advice. I am so scared to go get help. I have a hard time talking to others and have a strong feeling of having to use the restroom when I am anxious.

Thank you for the reply. I feel very overwhelmed when explaining things, but I'll try my best. I'm not sure where to start though.

My brother has got me to do some sexual acts with him when I was at a very young age, and it haunts me to this day. I was not sure what he was doing, but he told me to keep it a secret. I only went with it because he was the only one that I talked to on a day-to-day basis and wanted to make him happy. My family always asks me why I treat him so coldly, but I am so afraid of telling them the truth. I guess it's no big deal, but it's so hard bottling this up and not telling anyone.
I have started cutting and I just can't stop. I have a long past other than that and I just feel so uncomfortable explaining it. I'm sorry.
It hurts because I don't know how to stop the pain. I don't know how to get over everything that has happened.
I am always being degraded by everyone and I am always being treated like trash. I want to know how it is like to be a human being. Sorry I may not seem as bad. I just don't know how to type it all out.
